name: Kathmandu valley rim: Sundarijal to Nagarkot
why: Two days on the forested rim of the Kathmandu valley, through Tamang villages, with the Langtang and Ganesh Himal in a row and a night at Chisapani.
book: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park ticket at Sundarijal. Taxi from Kathmandu to Sundarijal (1 h); bus or taxi back from Nagarkot.
water: Tea shops in the villages and lodges at Chisapani.
dangers: Steep stone steps beside the Sundarijal water pipe.
Do not walk the forest alone: go with a guide or a group.
turnaround: If you are not at Chisapani by 16:00, the light goes fast in the forest: stop at the first lodge.

points.name: Sundarijal
points.note: Waterfalls and a reservoir at the gate of the national park.

points.name: Chisapani
points.note: Lodges on a ridge at 2,200 m with a long line of Himalayan peaks at dawn.

points.name: Nagarkot
points.note: The valley-rim village of hotels known for its sunrise over the Himalaya.
